input.rationale: Section 18 meets every preferred element: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers compensation as required by law, professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 granted unconditionally, which satisfies the Customer Data condition for this hosting vendor. Section 18.2 requires certificates of insurance on request and adds favourable extras such as primary coverage and notice of cancellation. No redline is warranted; this sits at our preferred position.
input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
